title: Identification and Functional Analysis of Human CD56neg NK Cells by Flow Cytometry
author: Orrantia, Terrén, et al.
materials: LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Aqua Dead Cell Stain Kit

Timing: 1–3 h4.If needed, reconstitute each recombinant human interleukin (IL):a.IL-18 reconstitution:i.Add 250 μL of cold and filtered double distilled water (ddH2O) to 25 μg lyophilized IL-18 to obtain a stock concentration of 100 ng/μL.ii.For further dilution of the stock solution prepare sterile PBS + (0.1%) BSA, using sterile PBS and sterile BSA Fraction V (7.5% solution). (See Materials and Equipment section).iii.Dilute the IL-18 stock concentration adding sterile PBS + BSA (0.1%) to obtain a final working concentration of 25 ng/μL.iv.Store aliquots at −20°C.b.IL-12 reconstitution:i.Add 100 μL of cold and filtered ddH2O and 25 μL of sterile PBS + BSA (0.1%) to 25 μg lyophilized IL-12 to obtain a stock concentration of 200 ng/μL.ii.Dilute the stock concentration adding sterile PBS + BSA (0.1%) to obtain a final working concentration of 5 ng/μL.iii.Store aliquots at −20°C.c.IL-15 reconstitution:i.Add 100 μL of cold and filtered ddH2O and 150 μL of sterile PBS + BSA (0.1%) to 25 μg lyophilized IL-15 to obtain a stock concentration of 100 ng/μL.ii.Dilute the stock concentration adding sterile PBS + BSA (0.1%) to obtain a final working concentration of 5 ng/μL.iii.Store aliquots at −20°C.Note: Aliquoting the reconstituted ILs is recommended to avoid freezing/thawing cycles.5.Reconstitute DNase I following manufacturer’s recommendation (https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/content/dam/sigma-aldrich/docs/Roche/Bulletin/1/11284932001bul.pdf). Briefly, reconstitute the lyophilized DNase I in sterile ddH2O to obtain a final stock concentration of 10 mg/mL (specific activity: 2,000 U/mg).Note: The working concentration of the DNase I is 10U up to 5 mL of media. We recommend aliquoting the stock solution to avoid freezing/thawing cycles. Store these aliquots at −20°C.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and media
steps.instruction: If required, make PBS, PBS + 2.5 % BSA, 8 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS, and the culture media as described in the Materials and Equipment section.

steps.title: Reconstitute interleukins and DNase I
steps.instruction: Reconstitute IL‑18, IL‑12, IL‑15 and DNase I to the indicated stock concentrations, prepare sterile PBS + 0.1 % BSA for dilutions, make working solutions, aliquot, and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: IL‑18: add 250 µL cold filtered ddH₂O to 25 µg lyophilized IL‑18 → 100 ng/µL stock; dilute with PBS + 0.1 % BSA to 25 ng/µL working; store aliquots at –20 °C.
IL‑12: add 100 µL ddH₂O + 25 µL PBS + 0.1 % BSA to 25 µg lyophilized IL‑12 → 200 ng/µL stock; dilute to 5 ng/µL working; store at –20 °C.
IL‑15: add 100 µL ddH₂O + 150 µL PBS + 0.1 % BSA to 25 µg lyophilized IL‑15 → 100 ng/µL stock; dilute to 5 ng/µL working; store at –20 °C.
DNase I: reconstitute lyophilized enzyme in sterile ddH₂O to 10 mg/mL (2 000 U/mg); working concentration is 10 U per up to 5 mL media; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs from buffy coat
steps.instruction: Perform Ficoll density‑gradient isolation using PBS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, collect the PBMC layer, wash, filter, and count viable cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL Ficoll‑Paque Plus to each of two 50 mL conical tubes.
Dilute buffy coat 1:4 with sterile PBS (add 30 mL PBS to 10 mL buffy coat). If starting from whole blood, dilute 1:2 with PBS.
Layer 20 mL diluted buffy coat gently on top of the Ficoll in each tube (tilt tube, avoid mixing).
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 20–25 min at 20–22 °C with low brake and acceleration.
Collect the PBMC layer with a Pasteur pipette into a 50 mL tube.
Add 30 mL sterile PBS, centrifuge 200 × g for 10 min at 20–22 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 30 mL sterile PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 20–22 °C; discard supernatant.
Repeat the 300 × g wash once more.
Resuspend pellet in 20 mL sterile PBS and filter through a 70 µm cell strainer.
Count viable cells by Trypan Blue exclusion.

steps.title: Cryopreserve PBMCs (optional)
steps.instruction: Freeze 1 × 10⁷ cells per cryovial in 50 % FBS and 50 % cryopreservation medium, then store at –80 °C for 48 h before transfer to liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cell cryopreservation medium.
Aliquot 1 × 10⁷ cells into a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 20–22 °C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in sterile FBS at 500 µL per 1 × 10⁷ cells.
Place 500 µL cell suspension into each cryovial and add 500 µL cryopreservation medium (final volume 1 mL).
Freeze vials in a controlled‑rate freezing container at –80 °C for 48 h, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Transfer cells to staining tubes
steps.instruction: After any incubation, label cytometry tubes for each condition, pipette the cell suspension from each well into the corresponding tube.

steps.title: Viability staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with LIVE/DEAD Aqua, wash, and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL PBS to each tube and centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL PBS.
Reconstitute LIVE/DEAD Aqua dye by adding 50 µL DMSO to the vial, mix until dissolved.
Add 1 µL reconstituted dye to every tube except the unstained control; vortex. Freeze any leftover dye per manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate 30 min on ice, protected from light.
Add 2 mL cold PBS + 2.5 % BSA, centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in the residual volume.

steps.title: Prepare extracellular antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: Make a 77 µL antibody mix per tube (add extra volume for safety) using the following volumes:

substeps.instruction: PE‑Vio770 NKp80 (Miltenyi, 130‑105‑068): 4 µL
Brilliant Stain Buffer (BD, 3794): 50 µL
PBS + 2.5 % BSA: 10 µL
Total per tube: 77 µL

steps.title: Extracellular staining
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with the antibody cocktail on ice, then wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 77 µL antibody mix to each tube (skip unstained control) and vortex.
Incubate 30 min on ice, protected from light.
Add 2 mL cold PBS + 2.5 % BSA, centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in the residual volume.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % PFA solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the 8 % PFA stock 1:2 with PBS to obtain 4 % PFA; prepare at least 150 µL per tube (more is advisable).

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Fix cells with 4 % PFA, wash twice, and resuspend in PBS + 2.5 % BSA.

substeps.instruction: Add 140 µL 4 % PFA to each tube, vortex.
Incubate 15 min on ice, protected from light.
Add 2 mL cold PBS + 2.5 % BSA, centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in the residual volume.
Repeat the PBS + 2.5 % BSA wash (step above).
Resuspend final pellet in 1 mL cold PBS + 2.5 % BSA and vortex.

steps.title: Store fixed cells overnight
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a 4 °C refrigerator, protected from light, until the next day.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Thaw tubes, wash, and permeabilize with BD Perm/Wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Vortex tubes taken from the fridge.
Centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in residual volume.
Prepare 3.5 mL of 1× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer per tube by diluting the 10× stock with ddH₂O.
Add 1 mL 1× Perm/Wash buffer to each tube, vortex.
Incubate 15 min at 20–22 °C (room temperature), protected from light.
Centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in residual volume.

steps.title: Prepare intracellular antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: Make a 58 µL antibody mix per tube using:

substeps.instruction: PerCP‑Cy5.5 IFNγ (BD, 560704): 205 µL
APC TNF (BioLegend, 502912): 33 µL
1× BD Perm/Wash™ Buffer: 50 µL
Total per tube: 58 µL

steps.title: Intracellular staining
steps.instruction: Incubate permeabilized cells with intracellular antibodies, then wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 58 µL antibody mix to each tube (skip unstained control) and vortex.
Incubate 30 min on ice, protected from light.
Add 2 mL 1× Perm/Wash buffer, centrifuge 300–400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for acquisition
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 200–400 µL PBS (or appropriate volume) and keep on ice until flow cytometer acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze flow data
steps.instruction: Run samples on the MACSQuant Analyzer 10, perform compensation, gate CD56⁻ NK cells, set positive gates for IFNγ, TNF, and CD107a, copy gates to stimulated conditions, calculate % positive cells, subtract non‑stimulated values, and record results (e.g., in Excel).

substeps.instruction: Open the non‑stimulated file, gate CD56⁻ NK cells.
Select each marker (IFNγ, TNF, CD107a) and FSC‑A, draw a gate at the population’s end (positive gate).
Optionally use FMO controls to define gates; prepare one FMO per marker per condition if used.
Paste the positive gates onto the K562‑stimulated and IL‑12 + IL‑15 + IL‑18‑stimulated files.
Calculate the percentage of positive cells for each marker in each condition, subtract the non‑stimulated percentage, and record the values (e.g., in Excel).
